Computer Science and Engineering
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science and Engineering!
Our Mission:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering is dedicated to empowering individuals to acquire cutting-edge computing skills through hands-on education and innovative research. Our goal is to address real-world challenges in Michigan and beyond.
Our Vision:
We aspire to be the premier destination for those in Michigan and beyond who seek to harness computing for the betterment of their communities.
Undergraduate Programs: We offer five separate undergraduate majors: Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Information Technology.
Combined B.S./M.S. Programs: We offer six combined bachelor's/master's degrees that provide students with an opportunity to complete a bachelor’s and master’s degrees in less time that would be necessary if the two degrees were obtained independently. These combined programs create an integrated learning experience along several knowledge paths.
• Computer Science, B.S., Software Engineering and Information Technology, M.S.
• Computer Science, B.S./Cybersecurity, M.S.
• Computer Science, Combined B.S./M.S.
• Information Technology, B.S./Computer Science, M.S.,
• Information Technology, B.S./Cybersecurity, M.S.
• Information Technology, B.S./Software Engineering and Information Technology, M.S.
Graduate Programs: Our graduate programs include M.S. in Artificial Intelligence, M.S. in Computer Science, M.S. in Cybersecurity, M.S. in Software Engineering and Information Technology, and the Ph.D. in Computer Science and Informatics.
The OU Pledge represents the university’s commitment to providing undergraduate students with meaningful, hands-on learning opportunities. Students in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering engage in experiential learning through their involvement in the following:
Collaborative projects and laboratories in core computer science and engineering courses
Applied Senior Design capstone projects
Internships with industry partners and organizations, providing real-world experience
Research opportunities under the mentorship of faculty members, including Research Experience for Undergraduates (funded by NSF)
Participation in hackathons, coding competitions and software development challenges, including hosting nationwide events through the GrizzHacks student organization
Participation in cybersecurity competitions through the CyberOU student organization
Hands-on semester projects in most required CSE courses

Message from the Chair
It is my great pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at Oakland University.
CSE is home to more than 900 students as we are the largest department at Oakland University. We offer ABET-accredited 5-year BS degrees in Computer Science and Information Technology, as well as BS in Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Data Science, producing graduates who have gone on to great success in industry and academia. Our MS programs in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering and Information Technology, and Cyber Security are designed to serve the needs of our students targeting multiple career paths in both academia and industry. The Ph.D. program in Computer Science and Informatics allows students to work with CSE faculty members to expand their knowledge in a variety of CSE areas. Together, these programs offer our students at all levels the opportunity to engage in research, experiential learning, and depth of study within the discipline, alongside dedicated faculty and a strong team of student-centered advisors and staff. Our faculty are dedicated to teaching and providing an engaging, rigorous, and welcoming classroom environment.
The department is also privileged to work with a large network of alumni and an advisory board that includes members from leading technical companies, including the local industry. This enables us to maintain a relevant curriculum and strong network for our new graduates, leading to a high job placement rate. Our research profile is also strong and growing, with several million dollars of grants awarded annually. Active research areas within the department include artificial intelligence, software engineering, cyber security, cryptography, data science, distributed systems, graphics and visualization, machine learning and pattern recognition, and programming languages.
We are particularly proud of our graduates. Our alumni are active near and far, developing innovative technologies and solving hard multidisciplinary problems. Please share your success stories with us, and we will highlight selected stories on our website.
I am extremely honored and humbled to lead our department into the future as we continue to move forward to embrace new opportunities and overcome new challenges. I hope that as you look further into our programs you will find that we have what you are looking for. This will inspire and equip you so that you can make a difference, with people who make a difference, at a time when it makes a difference.
At OU CSE, you can help build the future of computer science and engineering, going beyond technical instruction to creating an ethical, inclusive, and multidisciplinary discipline that makes a positive impact on the world. We invite you to learn more about our work and to join us. We continue to grow and improve as we strive to be an environment where students, staff and faculty can all work together to enable each other’s success!

Combined B.S./M.S. Programs
A combined bachelor/master degree program provides students an opportunity to complete a bachelor’s and master’s degree in less time than would be required if the two degrees were done independently. Students accepted for the B.S./M.S. program must have a minimum overall undergraduate GPA of 3.2. Students may apply to the B.S./M.S. program and be offered deferred admission to the graduate program during their junior year.

Stackable Certificates
We offer flexible stackable certificate programs designed to fit your career goals. These certificates can seamlessly lead to an M.S. degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, and Software Engineering and Information Technology. Developed in partnership with industry leaders, these programs focus on high-demand skills and cutting-edge technologies. Learn at your own pace, gain marketable expertise, and build a pathway to career success while advancing toward a master's degree.
